title: dryopteris sinofibrillosa
intro: Dryopteris sinofibrillosa, commonly known as the Chinese leather fern, is a type of plant species belonging to the Dryopteridaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine, exhibiting a range of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris sinofibrillosa are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and improve respiratory function. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
